summary: Babbel's main friction themes: Grammar understanding, lesson structure, subscription model, UI/UX, content depth, and user retention.

themes.name: Grammar Understanding
themes.description: Users feel Babbel lacks sufficient grammar explanation and depth compared to competitors like Duolingo, which is seen as more comprehensive in grammar teaching.
themes.recommendation: Enhance grammar explanations and provide more structured grammar lessons.

better than duolingo, far from perfect. I’ve been using Babbel to learn polish for four months now. I was a long time duolingo user (different languages) and Babbel is undeniably better. Lesson progress in a logical way and the grammar and pronunciation lessons are hugely helpful

themes.name: Subscription Model
themes.description: Users feel the subscription model is too expensive and not worth the investment, especially when free alternatives like Duolingo exist.
themes.recommendation: Offer more flexible pricing, free tiers, or discounts for long-term users.

quotes.text: Subscription. I downloaded this app because Duolingo sucked and I did a French lesson on the app I liked the design and thought it was good but then to do another lesson you have to get the subscription.
Subscription problem. I don’t think you should pay to learn and the subscriptions cost to much like i just want to learn german for free!!
No good n too expensive. Free version of Duolingo its much better. After one lesson, they just want to charge you…totally uncool

themes.name: Content Depth
themes.description: Users feel the content is outdated and lacks new material, especially for popular languages like Spanish and French.
themes.recommendation: Regularly update content and add new features like games and podcasts.

quotes.text: Good app, feels dated. Have done most of Spanish and started Italian. Lessons are good and I feel better from doing the reps. However all the side activities seem to be created a while ago and haven’t been updated. I’ve had for about a year and haven’t seen anything new (at least

Inappropriate content. I expected this app to have just a simple language learning format, instead, they go ahead and sprinkle forms of inappropriate PDA into the app that is very uncomfortable for young people and for people who don’t want to see inappropriate lifestyles. I do n

Content. I really like this app but you need to add some new content. Some games or something and definitely some more episodes of the podcasts. I really like the podcasts but I have listened to all of it and would like some new episodes. PLEASE!!!

themes.name: Lesson Structure
themes.description: Lessons are too long and not broken down into smaller segments, making it hard to maintain focus and progress.
themes.recommendation: Offer shorter, modular lessons with clear progression.

quotes.text: Lessons are confusing and advanced.. I’m not sure how you start your lessons and how you finish them, but you include words I never seen and expect me to know what to do with it. i’m really hating your lessons and I will not continue or recommend the service. I just don’t get it.

Average / Good. Throughout the lesson, the app hits on certain points that positively feed the mind. Yet too often, the student is asked to answer where “the process of elimination” automatically occurrs in selecting the correct response. This is frustrating and disappointing.

Frustrating app. On some pages, the buttons are extra sensitive and advance the lesson too quickly. Others, like the spelling lessons, the user has to hold the letter key down for it to accept your input. Distracts from the learning experience.

themes.name: UI/UX
themes.description: The app feels dated and not well-organized, with outdated layouts and confusing navigation.
themes.recommendation: Revamp the UI/UX to be more modern and intuitive.

quotes.text: Sucks. The lay out is pretty boring to the point it just doesn’t make it fun to enter not only that the ai voice recognition sucks, you can say a word right and it gets it wrong. I am not downloading the app again. Stick to Duolingo guys
Worst learning app.. This app is terrible. They give you questions about things they haven’t gone over and expect you to figure it out on your own. It is frustrating and makes you stop trying.

themes.name: User Retention
themes.description: Users struggle to maintain motivation due to the lack of gamification and the need for self-discipline.
themes.recommendation: Introduce gamification elements or progress tracking to improve retention.

quotes.text: Assumptions. Seems the tool assumes you master something when you barely squeeze through. As an older person. I need a lot of consistent repetition. A good AI tool would converse with me like a person.
Difficult to cancel. Recommend using an app that easily allows you to cancel.
Won’t stop auto draft. Tried multiple times to stop auto draft and they won’t quit. Good luck. Better programs out there.
